audience: Operations, recruiting, and people leaders defining support roles
designFamily: Offshore Resourcing Work Architecture: a technical blueprint system with electric blue, acid lime, cool paper, and hard-edged grid composition
heroComposition: Cool paper grid first fold with oversized ink Syne display, an acid-lime highlight bar, compact operating checks, a bright blue action, and a hard-edged documentary photo frame with a mono sample label
typeCharacter: Locally hosted Syne variable for wide geometric display, Karla for readable body copy, and DM Mono for labels, metadata, and controls
paletteFamily: Ink #0c1226, electric blueprint blue #2b3bff, acid lime #dcff4f, cool paper #f1f4fa, white, and slate copy with no low-contrast secondary text
shapeGrammar: Zero-radius panels and controls, one-pixel ink rules, hairline grid fields, corner labels, and no soft shadows
imageTreatment: Realistic editorial recruiting and operations photography inside sharp ink frames with mono captions and lime sample labels
sectionRhythm: Full-screen grid first fold, ink review band, white and paper operating sections, ink process rail, and a full-width electric-blue closing action
navigationTreatment: Sticky white subsidiary-first bar with three centered mono routes, compact StealthAgents attribution, a blue right-side action, lime hover states, and an accessible mobile menu
motionSignature: Short hover transitions, a delayed pausable review rail, and a static reduced-motion fallback
density: Dense and readable: the services directory surfaces all twelve lanes in three columns, and the contact form is complete above the first desktop fold
signatureElement: Acid-lime highlight bars inside oversized ink display type on a blueprint grid
